description: This file configures Axios HTTP client for API communication, including base URL resolution, token handling, and request/response interceptors for authentication token refresh logic in a React project.

methods.name: stripTrailingSlashes
methods.description: Removes trailing slashes from a URL string.

methods.name: ensureApiSuffix
methods.description: Ensures the base URL ends with '/api' or '/api/v1'.

methods.name: isKaviaPreviewHost
methods.description: Checks if running inside the Kavia preview environment based on hostname.

methods.name: getKaviaPreviewPublicOrigin
methods.description: Returns the public origin URL in Kavia preview environment.

methods.name: looksLikeKaviaProxyUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL appears to be a Kavia proxy URL.

methods.name: normalizeEnvBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes environment-provided base URL for API.

methods.name: resolveBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the API base URL based on environment variables and environment context.

methods.name: stripApiSuffix
methods.description: Removes '/api' or '/api/v1' suffix from a URL.

methods.name: formatAuthorizationHeaderValue
methods.description: Formats the authorization header value, ensuring no duplicate 'Bearer'.

methods.name: extractTokensFromResponse
methods.description: Extracts access and refresh tokens from API response data.
